Date: 08/25/2026

Sub: Offer of Internship with Srimatrix Health LLC

Dear Apliciant,

We are pleased to offer you the position of Healthcare Content Writing and Communications Intern with Srimatrix Health. We believe your skills and academic background will be a valuable addition to our organization.

Position Details

  • Position Title: Healthcare Content Writing and Communications Intern
  • Employment Type: Part-Time Internship
  • Hours: 10 hours per week
  • Work Location: Remote
  • Supervisor: Suneel Sah, Director
  • Start Date: 08/31/2026

Duties and Responsibilities

In this role, you will support the organization's healthcare content and communications activities. Your responsibilities may include:

  • Researching healthcare, medical, and public-health topics using credible sources.
  • Writing, editing, and proofreading healthcare-related articles, educational materials, newsletters, website content, and other communications.
  • Supporting digital content and communications initiatives.
  • Reviewing content for accuracy, clarity, readability, grammar, and consistency.
  • Assisting with content calendars, communications projects, and related administrative tasks.
  • Collaborating with team members on healthcare communication and content-development projects.
  • Performing other duties related to healthcare content writing and communications as assigned.

The position is intended to provide practical experience in healthcare content writing, communications, research, and professional communication, and the duties are related to your academic and professional field of study.

Srimatrix Health LLC

Healthcare Communications & Education Division

Employment Terms

You are expected to perform your duties professionally and in accordance with the policies and procedures of Srimatrix Health. This offer is contingent upon your maintaining appropriate authorization to work in the United States and satisfying any applicable employment requirements.

For an employee working under F-1 Optional Practical Training (OPT), employment is subject to the requirements and limitations applicable to the student's OPT authorization. The employee is responsible for maintaining valid immigration and employment authorization throughout the period of employment.

Srimatrix Health will provide appropriate supervision, assignments, and professional guidance related to the position.

Please indicate your acceptance by signing and returning this letter by 08/28/2026.

We are excited about the opportunity to have you join our team and look forward to your contributions to our healthcare content and communications initiatives.

Sincerely,

Suneel Sah

Director

Srimatrix Health LLC

Email: ssah@srimatrixhealth.com

Candidate Acceptance

I, apliciant, accept the position of Healthcare Content Writing and Communications Intern with Srimatrix Health under the terms described in this letter.
